build_conv_layer: build a Conv2d layer with optional batch normalization and leaky ReLU activation
build_i_conv_layer: build a Conv2d layer with optional batch normalization but no activation function
create_flow_predictor: create a Conv2d layer that predicts 2-channel optical flow from input feature maps
build_deconv_layer: build a transposed convolution layer with leaky ReLU for upsampling feature maps
init_deconv_bilinear_weights: initialize a transposed convolution weight tensor with bilinear interpolation kernel values
